{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |legacy_base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |legacy_speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |legacy_cash = {{Money|5}} on death |legacy_spawned_by = [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] |legacy_hidden = No |legacy_fly = No |legacy_ghost = No |legacy_lead = No |legacy_immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Skeleton''' is an enemy that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Challenge Trials]], [[Badlands II]], [[Polluted Wasteland II]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in the tutorial and first chapters of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The '''Skeleton''' is primarily summoned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], it does not appear naturally in most modes except [[Badlands II]]. A '''Skeleton''' summoned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] has a chance to have the [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] attribute. It has a decent amount health and speed. The '''Skeleton''' was replaced by the [[Brick Man]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== The '''Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. On death, the '''Skeleton''' falls into a pile of bones while playing a bone shaking sound. Its legacy version was pretty similar, though it has a different walking animation and no death animation. ==Strategy== *The '''Skeleton''' can be a threat when it first appears, as many can be summoned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] if it is not killed quickly, leading to other problems. **Killing the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] before it can summon any '''Skeletons''' is recommended. **Towers like the [[Soldier]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite effective against this. **High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Accelerator]] can be prepared specifically for this enemy if early game towers are not enough, using the [[Farm]] to get them as they may be quite expensive. ***Do note that the [[Accelerator]], if locked onto the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] or other strong enemies, will ignore the '''Skeletons''' until the targeted enemy is defeated or leaves its range. ***The [[Ranger]] struggles against hordes of '''Skeletons''' due to its slow firerate. It can instead be set to ''Strongest'' to target and kill the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] while other towers take care of the '''Skeletons'''. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Assassin]] can be quite useful as they can damage all the '''Skeletons''' as well as the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] at once. **The '''Skeletons''' can be converted by the [[Hacker]] to damage the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] that summoned them. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the '''Skeleton''' as it is a summoned enemy. *The '''Skeleton''' moves at a somewhat fast pace. You may want to use crowd control towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Warden]] or [[Electroshocker]], though this is not necessary. **The [[Sledger]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] are particularly effective as they can slow multiple '''Skeletons''' down at once. Additionally, their high damage makes them also useful at killing '''Skeletons'''. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{Tabber |Modern |{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:SkeletonDeath.ogg]] {{!}}Death sound {{!}}} |Legacy |{{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:SkeletonDeath2.ogg]] {{!}}Death sound {{!}}} }} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} SkeletonWalk.gif|Current walk animation (24 February 2024 – Present) SkeletonDeathAnimation.gif|Current death animation (24 February 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Legacy)}} LegacySkeletonWalk.gif|Current walk animation (29 July 2022 – Present) LegacySkeletonStunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (29 July 2022 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1Skeleton.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Skeleton.png|Overclock variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseSkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacySkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PirateUpdateThumbnail.png|'''Skeleton's''' head on the game thumbnail.
